WITH counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS disabled_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN d.name IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_disabled_count,
    COUNT(*) AS total_count
  FROM longest_absense_from_school AS l
  LEFT JOIN disabled AS d ON d.name = l.name
)
SELECT
  (disabled_count - non_disabled_count) * 100.0 / total_count AS percentage_difference,
  CASE WHEN disabled_count < non_disabled_count THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS disabled_students_better_attendance
FROM counts;
